records.title: Rational Synthesizers or Heuristic Followers? Analyzing LLMs in RAG-based Question-Answering
records.reason: GroupQA manipulates evidence quantity, redundancy, order, and conflict to study answer behavior. It contributes a dataset/behavior analysis and suggests deduplication or order randomization, but does not implement or evaluate a direct inference compute, memory, latency, or serving reduction.

records.title: Enhancing Linguistic Competence of Language Models through Pre-training with Language Learning Tasks
records.reason: L2T adds structured language-learning tasks during pretraining to accelerate linguistic competence acquisition. The reported effects concern pretraining and task performance; it supplies no inference-time compute, memory, token, or serving optimization.

records.title: Understanding and Mitigating Spurious Signal Amplification in Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Math Reasoning
records.reason: TTRL adapts models at inference using pseudo-labels and studies noisy optimization signals; this adds test-time adaptation rather than providing an inference-saving mechanism.

records.title: Targeted Exploration via Unified Entropy Control for Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: Unified entropy control is an RL exploration/training method for reasoning models; the abstract does not present inference compute or memory savings.

records.title: GFT: From Imitation to Reward Fine-Tuning with Unbiased Group Advantages and Dynamic Coefficient Rectification
records.reason: GFT combines imitation and reward fine-tuning for knowledge injection; the efficiency described is post-training/optimization, not deployed inference.
